name: toggle
title: Toggle
author: Hubert Formin <hformin@gmail.com>
description: A switch, or a whole settings row with its consequence. Use for a setting that takes effect immediately.

dontUseWhen: a form field that needs saving
hairline.example: <Toggle on label="Round up every payment" note="Adds about 4 200 a month to the vault." />
hairline.antiExampleWhy: No consequence stated, so the user cannot tell what turning it on does.

docs: Give it a `note`: a setting without its consequence stated is the most common copy failure in finance UIs.
